Subscribe: http://bit.ly/subPMJ | PMJ on Spotify: http://pmjlive.com/pmjspotify

PMJ's "modern-day Doris Day" Tatum Langley returns for a new-fashioned swing version of Olivia Dean's breezy song of the Summer, "So Easy (To Fall in Love)." Come get dressed up & experience PMJ live on tour in 60 cities across the US this Fall!
